For hanging strips like Command strips, pull slowly straight down, parallel to the wall, stretching the strip along its length until it releases, and warm it with a hairdryer for 20 to 30 seconds if it resists. For medical wound-closure strips, don't peel them off: leave them to fall off on their own, usually within about 7 to 10 days, and see a clinician if the wound reopens or looks infected. Neither option in the team note is quite right: a mandatory seven-day wait isn't a standard medical rule, and wound strips don't generally require a nurse or doctor to remove them.
